BiblicalUsage: Chere is dung, and it stands once, in the mouth of Rabshakeh at the siege of Jerusalem. He taunts the men on the wall that they will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with him, a crude threat meant to break their spirit before the Assyrian army.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Bible does not clean up the words of God's enemies, and their filth only shows the darkness they serve.
